name: global_block_local_status
comment: A central table that stores global blocks which are currently disabled on local wikis.

columns.name: gbls_gb_id
columns.comment: Foreign key to globalblocks.gb_id. Part of the composite primary key.

columns.name: gbls_wiki
columns.comment: The ID of the wiki where the global block is disabled. Part of the composite primary key.

columns.name: gbls_by_central_id
columns.comment: The central ID of the user who disabled the block locally.

columns.name: gbls_reason
columns.comment: The reason given for disabling the global block locally.
